lesson.menu_title: What Do You Like and What Do You Want?
lesson.menu_desc: Dinner with Laura after the Sao Paulo fair: free time, hobbies and dreams -- like / love / hate + -ing and want to
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 11 -- What Do You Like and What Do You Want?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Camillo Furlan Alfredini | Lesson 11 -- What Do You Like and What Do You Want?
lesson.grammar_point: like / love / hate + verb-ing and want to + verb (I love fishing, I don't like cooking, I want to visit)

listenings.text: Welcome to Porto Seguro Fishing Tours! Do you love fishing? Do you want to relax on the sea? Our boat leaves every Saturday at six in the morning. You don't need your own equipment. Do you hate waking up early? No problem: we also have a tour at two in the afternoon. After the tour, we cook your fish on the beach. Call us today!

Hi Camillo, it's Klaus from Munich. Thanks for your message. You asked about my free time. Well, I love cycling, and I like cooking for my family on Sundays. I hate running, it's boring! And my dream? I want to see a Formula 1 race in Brazil, at Interlagos. Do you want to come with me? Call me back!

extra_audio.text: Camillo and Laura are having dinner after the auto parts fair in Sao Paulo. Laura asks: What do you like doing in your free time? Camillo says: I love fishing, and I like watching Formula 1. Laura says: I love cycling, but I hate cooking. Camillo says: I want to visit Germany next year. Laura says: Great! I want to show you Munich.
